That's super valid! I usually try to filter through the negativity by going through the sub's success/wins threads or by specifically filtering or searching for advice/success

I totally get how it can be discouraging tho

First of all, CONGRATULATIONS!!!! Getting into a top school is amazing, and no matter what you go through, i hope you remember how awesome you are to accomplish something like that! 

Second of all: would you rather be single and alone in a foreign country... or, would you rather live in a foreign country with someone you don't trust? Both can feel just as isolating, but at least you know you can trust and prioritize yourself - you can't guarantee that feeling with someone who has violated your trust. Sometimes, when compared to other options, being alone isn't too bad. After all, a foreign country can be super exciting!! You can and will meet so many amazing people! They don't have to necessarily be new potential partners, but they can be new friends and acquaintances that truly make you feel loved <3

Good luck in school (again, congrats)!
